headline: Colonials Retake Two Posts in Mooring as Expanse Flares Anew
war_summary: Three hours on from our last edition, the morning's certainties have frayed. Mooring County, reported then as a clean Warden sweep of all twelve posts, now shows two of them back under the Colonial flag; forty-eight actions round the clock, Gravekeeper's Holdfast and MacConmara Barrows the most fought-over ground, with the day's returns past seven thousand Colonial and six thousand Warden casualties and both sides' losses still quickening. The Weathered Expanse has swung further still: five of nine posts fly Colonial colours against a single Warden holdfast, three remain no-man's-land, and ninety engagements — thirty-seven of them about Wightwalk — have cost upward of seven thousand Colonial and ten thousand Warden casualties. Callahan's Passage, till now a Warden wall of ten, has yielded one post, its latest flare-ups logged as this edition goes to press. The Nevish Line stands six posts to two with no base changes since early morning, though its casualty rates continue to climb. Linn Mercy's guns at last run cooler, while Stlican Shelf and Marban Hollow grind on without a settled flag of their own. Day 551; thirty-four victory towns unclaimed, no victor named.
